title: session.bind
description: Pair the hidden game's save slot with this Minecraft world. The server tells its client the world id (S→C); the client passes it to gen1-bridge (M→G).

incompatible.description: FOREIGN_POKEMON_PLAN §4.15, Q12: the region record's rules.compat.onIncompatible, what the link does with a member its game lacks; absent: visitor.

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
